GlobalPolicy.redaction: Never log password hashes, API-key/secret plaintext, TOTP secrets, OTP codes, or session tokens (hashed sha256 or never printed).
GlobalPolicy.test-scope-note: lib/test/** is OUTSIDE the documented scope: test files are referenced by path and by the npm test command only; their contents were not read or analyzed. Scenarios below are inferred from public behavior, not from test bodies.

VF-001.NAME: VersionedWrite
VF-001.scenario: create() inserts a new entity; update() inserts a new version (deep-merged) instead of mutating; invalid data is rejected.
VF-001.expected-outcome: A new Entity row exists per write; prior versions remain; ValidationError on schema violation; entity_check trigger blocks abstract/bad-link inserts.

required-signals.trace-sequence: splitPlan -> createOp/updateOp -> validate -> inTransaction -> insertOne -> read tail

VF-002.NAME: CascadeDelete
VF-002.scenario: delete({confirm:true}) tombstones the target and recursively deletes dependents; unauthorized delete is denied.
VF-002.expected-outcome: Target + dependents tombstoned via entity_delete trigger (advisory-locked); "acl denies DELETE" when unauthorized.

required-signals.trace-sequence: delOp -> ACL DELETE check -> deleteSql -> entity_delete cascade

VF-003.NAME: AclEnforce
VF-003.scenario: With enforceAcl and an account, reads are row-filtered and unauthorized reads/writes are denied by default.
VF-003.expected-outcome: Deny-by-default (no matching rule); "acl denies <op> on <class>" Error; row filter injected into buildRead.

VF-004.NAME: AuthVerify
VF-004.scenario: verifyPassword/verifyApiKey/verifyTotp/verifyOtp accept valid credentials and reject invalid ones without leaking timing or secrets.
VF-004.expected-outcome: AuthResult on success, null on failure; constant-time compare; dummy-verify on unknown identifier.

VF-005.NAME: Bootstrap
VF-005.scenario: up() provisions the container, applies DDL+seeds, waits for readiness and connects.
VF-005.expected-outcome: EntityDb connected to "v<version>.<schema>" (e.g. up({schema:'booking',version:1}) → "v1.booking"); clear [letopis.up] progress; explicit error if docker missing or timeout.

VF-006.NAME: TemporalRead
VF-006.scenario: Graph traversal, asOf(t) snapshots, versions() history, keyset after(cursor), and aggregations return correct results.
VF-006.expected-outcome: Latest-version reads by default; asOf reconstructs a point-in-time; versions lists history; slow queries surface via onQuery/console.warn.

scenarios.scenario-1: buildRead compiles forward/reverse hops and filters to correct parameterized SQL; runQuery returns rows.
scenarios.scenario-2: Unknown operator / no path A→B / LINK→LINK throw; transient errors retried up to RETRIES.
scenarios.scenario-3: Polymorphic read: a step on a parent class returns the parent plus every descendant (any depth); identity is (class, id); .exact() narrows back to the single class; a class without descendants keeps the single-equality fast path.
scenarios.scenario-4: Under enforceAcl a denied descendant is excluded from the parent step instead of leaking (acl.test.ts asserts no SportsCar row surfaces through Vehicle); when the whole family is denied the step throws "acl denies READ".
